panels.title: E13 · What does a useful outcome cost?
panels.description: Missing input, release R3: no number is shown. Contract: config/panel-contracts/ttv-economics.yaml (panel 1).

options.content:
**Release R3 · missing input.** This card shows no number until the inputs below exist.

**What it will show.** Energy cost and internal cost per comparable successful request, token category or approved business outcome, with shared and idle overhead shown separately and the AWS comparison kept apart. Changes in model or traffic mix are exposed, and an AWS proxy is never labelled as our cost.

**Missing inputs**

| Input | Where it would come from |
| --- | --- |
| Successful useful work per service (goodput criteria) | Serving counters of record and SLOs (E10, R2) |
| Measured energy and an approved electricity tariff | E15 (R2) and tariff configuration |
| Internal cost policy: acquisition or depreciation, support, allocations | Finance input, versioned in configuration |
| Comparable categories (model, workload, service quality) | Configuration |
| Business outcome measures, if any | Approved, independently measured inputs only |

**Onboarding step.** After E10 and E15, load the tariff and the internal cost policy and define comparable categories; each money view then shows its own unit cost, never summed.

**Answer today (R1).** [Queues](/d/ttv-queues) shows the AWS-equivalent value of idle GPU-hours: a comparison, not our cost and not a loss.

panels.title: E15 · Is power or facility capacity limiting growth?
panels.description: Missing input, release R2: no number is shown. Contract: config/panel-contracts/ttv-economics.yaml (panel 2).

options.content:
**Release R2 · missing input.** This card shows no number until the inputs below exist.

**What it will show.** Measured server and GPU power and energy (server power already includes its GPUs, so the two are never added), energy drawn while idle, consumption trends, and approved site or rack power and cooling budgets where supplied. Measured use, engineered budgets and facility limits stay separate.

**Missing inputs**

| Input | Where it would come from |
| --- | --- |
| Server power with a defined measurement boundary | BMC/Redfish readings via server-scan or the profile-less collector (read-only) |
| GPU power and energy counters | DCGM exporter through Thanos, with a versioned field mapping |
| Electricity tariff and optional PUE | Configuration; PUE applies to IT energy only |
| Approved site/rack power and cooling budgets, redundancy policy | Facilities engineering, versioned import |

**Onboarding step.** R2 adds power and energy collection with coverage reporting; facilities then import budgets. Without budgets the page shows consumption only and draws no growth conclusion.

**Answer today (R1).** No R1 page measures power. [GPU use](/d/ttv-gpu-use) shows which GPUs do work, [Queues](/d/ttv-queues) which are idle.
